english: Fox's Hash
Diced potato and egg fried up quick on the grill. Simple, honest, and hits the spot when you're running on fumes.
Mushroom Omelette
A fluffy omelette stuffed with wild mushrooms. Fancy? No. Delicious? Absolutely.
Honey Corn Cake
Sweet corn cake drizzled with honey. Tastes like the apocalypse isn't even happening.
Forager's Broth
A humble broth of mushrooms, corn, and boiled water. What the wilderness provides, the fox makes delicious.
Burnt Ends
Charred meat slow-cooked with fresh cuts. One survivor's trash is another survivor's BBQ. Recipe by Maltaine.
Country Fried Steak
Sham sandwich breaded with egg and served with grilled meat. Proof that anything can be redeemed with enough hot oil. Recipe by Maltaine.
Blueberry Smoothie
Blended blueberries and water. Cold, refreshing, and purple enough to make you feel fancy.
Aloe Cooler
Aloe and blueberry blended smooth. The wellness influencers of the old world would be proud.
Herbal Honey Tea
Honey, aloe, and yucca fiber brewed in hot water. Nature's antibiotic. Grandma was right all along.
Espresso Smoothie
Hot coffee meets cold snowball. The wasteland's answer to iced espresso. Warning: may cause excessive looting speed.
Fox's Breakfast
Bacon and eggs paired with fresh corn bread. Start the day right, even if the day includes a blood moon.
Wasteland Chowder
Sham chowder elevated with grilled corn. Proof that even Shamway products can be redeemed.
Hunter's Bounty
Meat stew, baked potato, and a boiled egg walk into a cooking pot. Nobody leaves hungry.
Scavenger's Stir Fry
Veggie stew, grilled meat, and corn bread all tossed together. A meal assembled from the spoils of a good day's scavenging.
Kitsune Gumbo
The fox's signature dish. Gumbo stew, fish tacos, and grilled corn fused into something legendary. Spicy enough to keep the zombies away.
Survivor's Feast
Steak and potato, spaghetti, AND blueberry pie? This is what peak apocalypse performance looks like. The ultimate reward for mastering the kitchen.
Hearty
Health regeneration and physical damage resistance.
Energized
Stamina regeneration and increased run speed.
Spicy
Stamina regeneration and strong physical damage resistance.
Well Fed
Full health and stamina regeneration, damage resistance, and increased block damage.
Refreshed
Light health and stamina regeneration.
Wired
Increased stamina regeneration and run speed. Gotta go fast.
Herbal Remedy
Gentle health regeneration and natural infection treatment.
Walker Milkshake

The cursed secret menu. Blended fresh from the worst the wasteland has to offer. Chug it and every walker within 100m comes to investigate your exact location for the next minute. Damn right it's better than yours.
Brings All the Walkers to the Yard
You reek of death on purpose. Maximum scent for 60 seconds - the horde is coming to find out who smells so delicious. Hold your milkshake.
Harvest Pumpkin Soup
Roasted pumpkin and sweet corn simmered down to something warm and golden. Tastes like a harvest festival nobody's around to throw anymore.
Kitsune Udon
Hand-cut corn noodles in miso broth, topped with a golden fried pocket. The fox's favorite dish since long before the dead started walking. Eat it and the fox shares a little of its luck.
Hot Honey Chicken
Crispy chicken nuggets and corn bread drowned in hot honey. Your coop works hard. Reward yourself.
Harvest Pot Pie
Ash chicken stew baked under a pumpkin bread crust. Smells like home and nothing else, which is exactly how you want it.
Pumpkin Spice Latte
Coffee, fresh pumpkin, and a swirl of honey. The world ended, but the seasonal menu didn't. Basic? Maybe. Warm all the way down? Absolutely.
Cozy
Stamina regeneration and resistance to the cold.
Fox's Favor
The fox shares its luck. Better loot and faster looting.
